subject: Verified baseline: head-anchor test line 118 predates Storyboard update
body:
Concrete baseline evidence now supplements the earlier label. The unmodified current test fails at line 118:114 in three controlled runs: preserved 06:13 UTC renderer plus actual pre-story catalog; current renderer plus that same catalog; current renderer plus published catalog. All pass their first two head checks and fail only because the expected working purpose chip is absent. The actual preserved renderer SHA is 624f0f2b76d15d4da13559dcaacf70c34bf1e38cf25e305b16d0cb2f678cda07. Its allPurposeControls and compactAllFiles functions (lines 750–780) are text-identical to current lines 751–781 after newline normalization; combined SHA 9552828533fdac7f1ddebbc2b23a94e7ab25a3fb97355053d9e61eca958825d5. The earlier all_files_outfits_first_20261014/CHANGE.json records Ziggy requesting that removal at 01:59 UTC.

Disposition: pre-existing stale test expectation, not introduced by this Storyboard update. No app/test/source edits, rebuild or push. Precise limitation: preserved full renderer is the earlier 06:13 snapshot, not an immediate 22:19 pre-edit backup; relevant functions are unchanged and actual pre-story data was used to isolate behavior. No unrelated Git HEAD substituted. Exact pins, rerun outcomes, source ranges and limitations are attached.

attachments.description: Before/after source comparison and three exact failure reproductions
